method: Set aside 3 or 4 of the dried chillies; soak the rest in 125ml water. Also set aside 4-6 of the cloves and 1 tbsp of the ghee.
Mix the yoghurt with the cumin seeds, ground coriander, chilli powder and salt. Set aside.

Heat the rest of the ghee in a heavy-bottomed pan. Add the remaining cloves, the bay leaves and both cardamoms. When they crackle, add the garlic and sauté for 2 minutes until golden. Add the onions and cook for 10 minutes until golden brown, stirring constantly.

Stir in the meat and cook for 2-3 minutes. Drain the soaked chillies and add to the pan. Cook for 10-12 minutes until the liquid has evaporated and the meat starts to brown. Add the spiced yoghurt and cook another 10-12 minutes until its liquid has evaporated.
Add the stock or water and bring to the boil, then cover, reduce the heat and simmer until the meat is tender. Check the seasoning and keep warm.

For the tadka, heat the reserved ghee in a small pan, add the reserved cloves and dried chillies and cook for 1-2 minutes until the ghee changes colour. Pour over the curry, sprinkle with the coriander and serve.
